items.exampleEn: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
items.exampleZh: 我們今晚出去吃晚餐吧。

items.exampleEn: The cat jumps into the box.
I just want a glass of water.
David is my friend. I see him every day.
items.exampleZh: David 是我的朋友，我每天都會見到他。

items.exampleEn: Could you open the door, please?
My brother is taller than me.
The other students are in the classroom.

items.sentenceEn: Could you help me with this box?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？

items.audioEn: Ben is older than his sister. He is twelve.
items.audioZh: Ben 比他妹妹年紀大，他十二歲。

items.sentenceEn: Put the milk into your bag.
I just want to go out and play.

items.stemEn: This bag is bigger ____ that one.
The dog runs ____ the house when it rains.
items.stemZh: 下雨時，狗會跑進屋子裡。

items.passageEn: David has a little brother. His name is Jack. Jack is just five, and David is older than him. On Sunday, they go out to the park with other children. When it starts to rain, they run into a small shop and wait there.
items.passageZh: David 有一個弟弟，名字叫 Jack。Jack 才五歲，David 比他大。星期天，他們和其他小朋友一起出去公園玩。開始下雨時，他們跑進一間小店裡，在那裡等雨停。

items.promptZh: 可以請你給我你的電話號碼嗎？
referenceEn: Could you give me your phone number, please?
Could you give me your phone number?
rubricZh: 用 Could you 開頭表示客氣的請求
請對方提供電話號碼的說法（例如 give me、tell me）接 your phone number

items.instructionZh: 用 than 造一個句子，比較兩個人或兩樣東西。
referenceEn: My cat is smaller than my dog.
My bag is bigger than your bag.
rubricZh: 句子有主詞和動詞（be 動詞或一般動詞都可以）
